build_wam_model: build a WAM model that embeds messages into images and detects them as masks using embedder, detector, and augmenter components
create_wam_forward_pass: create a forward pass that generates watermarked images from input images and masks with optional message injection
test_wam_embed_method: test the WAM embed method that generates watermarked images from input images and optional messages for inference
test_wam_detect_method: test the WAM detect method that performs watermark detection by rescaling images and computing predicted masks and messages
review_wam_blend_method: review the WAM blend method that blends original images with predicted watermarks using configurable scaling factors
